reviewer: /root/helper_flow (extractor implementer); root requested review; N/P source reviewers cross-checked judgments.
scope: Eight hand-selected development-seen mechanisms; measures retrospective retrieval on this labeled pilot, not general recall or defect-detection efficacy.

definitions.exact_seed_hit: Manual test_id occurs in an emitted gap.test_ids, not merely tests.json.
definitions.step_hit: Manual step_id occurs in an emitted gap.step_ids.
definitions.joint_hit: Same emitted gap links at least one exact seed and at least one manual step.
definitions.semantic_same_origin: Separate manually checked historical source match; never increases exact-ID numerator.
definitions.mechanism_verdict: Separate human full/partial/missed judgment. Identity overlap alone does not establish mechanism.
definitions.full: Direct evidence for the target gap mechanism is recovered as linked signals; no claim of confirmed defect, oracle validity, exhaustive execution coverage or new combination generation.
definitions.partial: At least one mechanism-specific fact is extracted, while required binding, observation or temporal facts remain absent.
definitions.missed: Only broad input/step/name overlap is recovered; no mechanism-specific discriminating fact is extracted.
definitions.manual_deep_review_budget: At most ten selected relevant/noise signals per case; index scans used for mechanical matching do not constitute exhaustive semantic review. Complete manual seeds and listed original steps were read. Large transitive evidence lists were not all semantically reviewed.
